name: face click
fusion: Clicking a face (TOP, FRONT, ...) animates the camera to that standard view.

name: edge click
fusion: Clicking one of the 12 edges animates to the 45-degree view between the two faces.

name: corner click
fusion: Clicking one of the 8 corners animates to that isometric view.

name: hover highlight
fusion: Hovering a face, edge or corner highlights that hot spot in blue before clicking.

name: home button
fusion: The house icon above the cube returns to the Home view, animated.

name: rotate arrows
fusion: With a face view active, curved arrows rotate the view 90 degrees about the view axis.

name: adjacent arrows
fusion: With a face view active, triangle arrows on each side roll to the adjacent face.

name: drag orbit
fusion: Dragging the cube orbits the model freely.

name: menu
fusion: The dropdown next to the cube: Go Home, Orthographic / Perspective, Set current view as Home or Front, Reset Front.

name: compass ring
fusion: The compass ring under the cube can be dragged to spin the view about up.

name: fade when idle
fusion: The cube is translucent until the pointer approaches.

name: axis triad
fusion: A small XYZ triad sits at the cube's lower-left corner.

name: orbit
fusion: The bottom navigation bar has Orbit (free / constrained), Look At, Pan, Zoom, Fit.

name: display settings
fusion: Display Settings flyout: visual style, environment, effects, object visibility, camera, ground plane.

name: grid snaps
fusion: Grid and Snaps flyout: layout grid, snap to grid, grid settings, incremental move.

name: viewports
fusion: Viewports flyout: single / multiple views.

name: look at
fusion: Look At, then a face, rotates the camera normal to it.

name: hover face
fusion: Hovering a face highlights it (blue tint) before any click.

name: hover edge
fusion: Hovering an edge thickens and highlights it.

name: hover vertex
fusion: Hovering a vertex shows a point highlight.

name: hover sketch
fusion: Hovering a sketch curve highlights it; profiles highlight on hover when a command wants a profile.

name: click select
fusion: Click selects; selected entities draw in a stronger blue than hover.

name: ctrl shift select
fusion: Ctrl or Shift+click adds to or removes from the selection.

name: window select
fusion: Left-to-right drag is window select, right-to-left is crossing select, with different box styles.

name: select other
fusion: Press and hold the left button shows Select Other, a list of the entities under the pointer.

name: middle pan
fusion: Middle drag pans; Shift+middle drag orbits; the wheel zooms toward the pointer.

name: double click loop
fusion: Double-clicking an edge selects its tangent chain or loop.

name: origin planes
fusion: Commands that need a plane show the origin planes as translucent squares that highlight on hover.

name: tooltip on hover
fusion: Hovering an entity during a command shows a small context tooltip (Select a plane or planar face).

name: empty click clears
fusion: Clicking empty space clears the selection.

name: escape clears
fusion: Escape cancels the command, then clears the selection.

name: ring
fusion: Right-click opens an 8-slot ring: Repeat, Delete, Press Pull, Redo, Hole, Sketch, Move/Copy, Undo.

name: overflow
fusion: A list under the ring: OK/Cancel, Pan, Zoom, Orbit options, Show All, Workspace, recent commands with shortcuts.

name: context aware
fusion: Ring and list change for faces, edges, bodies, sketches and browser items.

name: flick
fusion: Right-drag in a direction runs that slot without waiting for the menu (marking gesture).

name: hover preview
fusion: Hovering a slot highlights it and shows the command's tooltip.

name: workspace switcher
fusion: Workspace dropdown at the left (Design, Generative, Render, ...).

name: tabs
fusion: Tabs per workspace: SOLID, SURFACE, MESH, SHEET METAL, PLASTIC, UTILITIES, MANAGE, TOOLS.

name: panel dropdowns
fusion: Each panel name (CREATE, MODIFY, ...) opens a dropdown with every command.

name: pin to toolbar
fusion: Commands in dropdowns can be pinned to the panel or the toolbar.

name: rich tooltip
fusion: Hovering a command shows a tooltip; resting longer expands it with an illustration and description.

name: contextual tab
fusion: Entering a sketch switches to a SKETCH tab with FINISH SKETCH at the right.

name: qat
fusion: Quick access toolbar: data panel, File menu, Save, Undo, Redo.

name: tree
fusion: Browser tree: document settings, named views, origin, bodies, sketches, components.

name: eye toggle
fusion: Each node has a visibility eye that toggles on click.

name: hover highlight
fusion: Hovering a browser node highlights the entity in the canvas.

name: context menu
fusion: Right-click on a node gives a node-specific menu (Rename, Delete, Create Components from Bodies, ...).

name: rename dblclick
fusion: Double-click or slow-click a name to rename it in place.

name: drag reorder
fusion: Bodies and components can be dragged between folders and components.

name: activate component
fusion: The radio button next to a component activates it.

name: collapse
fusion: The browser panel collapses to a narrow strip and can be pinned.

name: icons
fusion: Each feature is an icon in the timeline at the bottom; hovering highlights the feature in the canvas.

name: dblclick edit
fusion: Double-clicking an icon reopens the feature's dialog.

name: rollback marker
fusion: Dragging the marker rolls the model back; features after it grey out.

name: drag reorder
fusion: Dragging an icon reorders features, with a red line where it can't go.

name: context menu
fusion: Right-click: Edit Feature, Edit Profile Sketch, Suppress, Delete, Roll History Marker Here, Create Group.

name: playback
fusion: Playback buttons: to beginning, step back, play, step forward, to end.

name: error badges
fusion: Failed features turn red or yellow with a warning tooltip.

name: heads up input
fusion: Drawing a line or rectangle shows length and angle boxes that follow the cursor; Tab cycles them.

name: inference lines
fusion: Dotted inference lines snap to horizontal, vertical and other points.

name: constraint glyphs
fusion: Constraints draw as glyphs next to geometry; hovering a glyph highlights the constrained items.

name: dimension leaders
fusion: Dimensions draw with extension lines, arrows and the value; double-click edits the value.

name: fully constrained color
fusion: Fully constrained curves turn black; underconstrained curves stay blue.

name: sketch palette
fusion: Sketch Palette: Options (look at, grid, snap, slice, profile, points, dimensions, constraints) and Finish Sketch.

name: drag geometry
fusion: Dragging underconstrained geometry moves it live while constraints hold.

name: profile shading
fusion: Closed profiles shade light orange.

name: finish returns view
fusion: Finish Sketch animates the camera back to the view before the sketch.

name: command dialog
fusion: Feature dialogs dock top-right of the canvas with OK/Cancel, a collapsible header and a help icon.

name: selection rows
fusion: Selection rows show a count (1 selected) with an X to clear and a blue arrow when active.

name: live preview
fusion: Features preview live while the dialog is open.

name: manipulators
fusion: Arrows and rotation handles in the canvas drag values (extrude distance, fillet radius).

name: value expressions
fusion: Value boxes take expressions and units (10 mm + 2 in, d1 * 2).

name: enter ok
fusion: Enter commits, Escape cancels.

name: s toolbox
fusion: S opens Design Shortcuts: recent commands plus a search box.

name: keys
fusion: Single keys: E extrude, F fillet, Q press pull, H hole, D dimension, L line, R rectangle, C circle, M move, J joint, I measure, X construction, V visibility.

name: customize
fusion: Shortcuts can be reassigned from each command's ... menu.

name: data panel
fusion: Data panel (grid icon) slides in with projects and files.

name: document tabs
fusion: Document tabs across the top, with + for a new design.

name: notifications
fusion: Job status, notification bell, help and profile at the top right.

name: status bar
fusion: Selection info such as 1 Profile | Area: 2.00 in^2 at the lower right.

name: text commands
fusion: Text Commands panel at the bottom.

name: comments
fusion: Comments panel at the lower left.
